blockingFindings.finding: validateSelfTestReport accepts any non-empty all-passed scenario list, so a one-scenario report can satisfy the unified full gate despite the frozen fixed fault matrix.
formalArtifactSnapshot omits test-results/package-artifact.json although the frozen contract permits only the package-building profile to update the package artifact manifest.
runProcess discards terminateProcessTreeAsync results on timeout, so TIMEOUT evidence does not prove direct-child or descendant cleanup and cannot classify timeout cleanup failure.
Packaged convergence scans executionDir/installDir strings but omits the dedicated process-temp path used by NSIS descendants.
Registry observation accepts every reg.exe code 1 as observable no-match evidence, although code 1 may also represent query failure.
Layer report validation binds command to self-declared expectedFiles but does not bind expectedFiles to the current task manifest.
The unified report knownLimitations omits the independently reproduced same-path immediate NSIS 0xC0000005 residual risk; isolated-path 5/5 is a mitigation, not an upstream root-cause proof.

requiredFixDirection: Define and validate one versioned exact-order self-test scenario contract; reject missing, duplicate, renamed or extra scenarios and bind expected classifications.
Add packageArtifactManifest to every formal artifact snapshot and add a manifest-only mutation fault proof.
Return structured timeout termination evidence; classify cleanup failure separately and self-test that child PID/listener/fixture actually converge.
Include process-temp in packaged convergence and strengthen installer/uninstaller process observation without fixed sleeps.
Replace ambiguous reg.exe code-1 observation with a fail-closed canonical PowerShell registry query using ErrorAction Stop.
Pass current manifest expectedFiles into layer schema validation and require exact ordered equality.
Disclose the historical same-path NSIS crash in the machine-authoritative unified report knownLimitations.
nonBlockingHardening: A same-user concurrent parent-swap TOCTOU remains between report revalidation and path-based rename. Static symlink/junction escape is blocked. The frozen architecture does not define a hostile same-user process threat model; address under SEC hardening or revise the architecture before treating it as a GOV-03 blocker.
Coverage registry hash, exemptions and inventory relationships can be bound more tightly to current scope/manifest metadata.
Standalone parse-time CLI failures may leave an older default report; consumers must pair reports with the current process exit until invocation nonces are added.
